recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-38171 unless the work group intentionally reopens the design to add explicit operator codes or alter search-prefix semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-38171 was a Published/Persuasive vocab R5 change request asking for comparative CodeSystem filter support for dateTime, integer, and decimal properties and clarification of dateTime precision behavior. The accepted resolution was Michael Lawley's proposal to avoid new operators and use the existing '=' operator with FHIR search prefixes in the value.
initial_application: Git commit 6ba28a62fc02ab39d84279e575608931a602f0a7 explicitly applied FHIR-38171 by adding CodeSystem filter search-prefix guidance and retiredDate examples to source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml. The current filter-operator CodeSystem still intentionally has no gt/lt/ge/le codes.
additional_context: The cited Zulip thread confirms the original use case, the prefix-on-value proposal, and the implementation commit. It also led to FHIR-40753, a later ValueSet cross-reference request that was retracted/resolved no-change; current ValueSet source now links ValueSet.compose.include.filter.value to valueset.html#filter-values and says ordered property types may use search prefixes. FHIR-40504 mentioned applying similar semantics in ConceptMap, but it is a separate artifact and decision path.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. CodeSystem and ValueSet are active build-scope resources in source/fhir.ini, and the current source already conveys the accepted rule across the CodeSystem filter narrative, the ValueSet filter-values narrative, and the ValueSet filter.value definition. Adding comparative operator codes would contradict the accepted resolution.

related_jiras.note: Follow-up asking for a ValueSet-to-CodeSystem filter cross-reference; it was retracted/resolved no-change, and current ValueSet source now contains filter-value guidance and links.
ConceptMap property work mentioned adopting similar FHIR-38171 prefix semantics for ConceptMap parameters, but it is a separate artifact and decision path.
